Imposing Build.description:
💪 Build: Imposing Build
Large and intimidating — height and breadth combine with posture that fills doorways and draws attention. A frame that other people notice first.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Imposing Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Imposing frame — large, physically dominant, filling the frame with sheer scale. Wide shoulders, thick neck, heavy brow. The body crowds the composition. Female: shoulders wide and squared over a defined waist, strong neck, firm rounded jaw, the chest line above a defined waist. Male: shoulders and neck massive, brow and jaw heavy, a massive flat chest with little taper. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at dominating scale.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
